# Preface

A rain barrel at each corner collects water from the shelter roof. Seedlings start in the cold frame and move out after the last frost. Paths between the beds are wide enough for a wheelbarrow to pass.

# Acknowledgements

## Volunteers

The bench by the pond is a good place to sort seed packets. Each season ends with a shared meal and a swap of saved seeds.

# Chapter 1

## Overview

### Detail

The lighthouse lamp turns once every twelve seconds. Keepers logged the wind direction at the top of every hour.

# Chapter 2

## Overview

### Detail

A brass barometer hangs beside the stairs to the lantern room. Fog signals sounded in groups of two when visibility dropped.

# Chapter 3

## Overview

### Detail

The station records temperature, pressure and humidity each minute. Readings older than a year move to the archive drive.

# Chapter 4

## Overview

### Detail

A bicycle chain needs a drop of oil on every link, then a wipe. Brake pads wear faster in wet weather and on long descents.

# Chapter 5

## Overview

### Detail

The reading room opens at nine and closes at six on weekdays. Maps larger than the tables are kept flat in the plan chest.

# Chapter 6

## Overview

### Detail

The north bed holds the early beans and two rows of lettuce. Water reaches each plot through a drip line laid under the mulch.

# Chapter 7

## Overview

### Detail

Volunteers record rainfall every morning before the gate opens. The tool shed keeps spades, forks and a wheelbarrow with a spare tyre.

# Chapter 8

### Detail
